source.excerpt: Working hard for something we don't care about is called stress. Working hard for something we love is called passion.
trail: The official homepage ↗ reproduces both sentences and signs them Simon Sinek.
His Golden Circle explanation ↗ places purpose and belief at the center of his account of motivation.
source.rightsNote: This modern English quotation appears on Sinek’s current official website, which carries an explicit copyright notice. The short passage is reproduced for identification and commentary, not as a public-domain text.

author.name: Simon Sinek
author.heading: About Simon Sinek
author.bio: Simon Sinek writes about leadership and the purposes that make people want to follow an organization. His books include Start with WHY, Leaders Eat Last and The Infinite Game; he also founded The Optimism Company.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The contrast fits Sinek’s larger distinction between doing a task and understanding the purpose behind it. His Golden Circle model treats a person’s or organization’s reason for acting as more important than its outward activities; the quotation compresses that approach into two ways the same effort can feel.
